name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.41.0 — executes-tier collision closure (specs/20260830/01-collision-closure-exec-recall.md): collision-closure.js's paths leg now matches a File Plan target's two-segment path suffix and tiers hits on runnable targets as `executes`, so tests that spawn a script by its root-stripped path are visible at plan lock; the remedy/honesty lines stop asking planners to waive `likely` hits. 7.40.3 — conventions first, genesis is init (specs/20260827/04-genesis-conventions-handoff.md): the ops-conventions ADR's table becomes machine-readable — `.claude/genesis/conventions.json` (schemaVersion 1, the nine ops floor rows plus any derived rows, each DECIDED or DEFERRED-with-reason, an enforceable DECIDED row naming a probe under `testTree`) is validated by `--mark decided`, and every checker-enforceable DECIDED row's probe file is required to exist and be non-empty by `--mark skeleton-landed`, alongside a new ≤150-line root `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` binding subset naming the gate command and the test tree — the conventions probe suite this closure lands runs forever in the gate. `HANDOFF` stops being the terminal state and becomes a judgment step instead: the session authors `.claude/genesis/init-profile.json` (the same shape `/spec:init` Phase 4 authors) and `--mark profile-written [--refresh]` has the driver run `init-gen.js generate` against it directly (log at `.claude/genesis/init-gen.log`, remedies keyed on its exit code), landing the new terminal state `GROUNDED` with `next: /spec:enforce`. Greenfield genesis is now init + enforce; `/spec:init` stays the brownfield entry and the regeneration owner (`--refresh` on a genesis-grounded repo). `spec/commands/genesis.md`'s HANDOFF report changes to match: `{P} convention probes` in its outcome, and its chain bullet now ends at `/spec:enforce` instead of `/spec:init`. 7.40.2 — design becomes a driver state (specs/20260827/03-genesis-design-state.md): the design lock folds into genesis-driver.js as a new `DESIGN` state between `ROADMAP` and `HANDOFF`, mark-driven — `doctrine-drafted` (a one-page `docs/design/doctrine.md`, `## Dissents` carrying every rejected direction) → `tokens-landed` (visual archetypes only: the winner's `tokens.css` ratified verbatim, an approved matrix-expanded mock passing `design-atlas.js check --matrix`, `design/components.json` present) → `rules-locked` (`design-rules.json` category/grounding enums valid, `components-check.js` green). `backend-api`/`data-ml` are written `design: skipped`; non-visual archetypes skip the tokens mark. Once `rules-locked` is accepted the driver prunes the losing `design/explore/` candidates, the gallery, the throwaway sketch, and the authored-tokens snapshot — an act of the accepted mark, never a step a session could forget. `/spec:genesis-design` is deleted: its command file, its `shared-for` map entry (`/spec:genesis` now serves § Design Authoring Contracts directly), its `entrypoints.json` rows, and its arm in `genesis-state-gate.sh`'s `case` lists (and the now-callerless `require_scaffold` helper) are all gone — a stray `/spec:genesis-design` prompt now falls through the hook untouched, and the hook gates only `/spec:init` on a partial canon. HANDOFF always points at `/spec:init` next. A repo-wide sweep (`tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js`) pins that no live surface still names the retired command.
